title: Train the pathway, deposit the computation: a two-probe dissociation of component ownership in transformer emergence — code and data
description: This archive is the experiment code and recorded result logs for Train the pathway, deposit the computation: a two-probe dissociation of component ownership in transformer emergence. Freeze probes ask which sub-network must be trained; mean-ablation probes ask where the trained computation sits. Arms are synthetic Boolean degree-staircase targets and in-context induction streams. Code: MIT; result logs: CC-BY-4.0. Concept DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21020348. Version DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21882597.
